references.title: Jaswant Singh Neki, Basking in the Divine Presence: A Study of Jaap Sahib

references.inspectionMethod: Read the retrieved PDF text for the identified chhands. The web screenshot endpoint returned placeholders, so no visual-inspection claim is made for this PDF.

references.title: Sant Sewa Singh, Nitnem Saral Steek, Gurdwara Rampur Khera
references.sourceType: Punjabi commentary published by the author's institution
references.locator: Printed pages 65–67 / PDF indices 72–74: 46 and first pair of 47 on page 65; remainder of 47 through 50 on page 66; 51–52 on page 67.

references.title: Sikh Translations, Chh. #44–63 Bhujang Prayaath Chhand & Chaacharee Chhand

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha, Mahan Kosh: ਤਾਨ
references.sourceType: Historical Punjabi dictionary entry reproduced digitally

references.inspectionMethod: Read the historical section and identify the separate dictionary attributions.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha, Mahan Kosh: ਅਸਤ੍ਰ

references.inspectionMethod: Read the historical definition and distinguish the unrelated Maya Singh headword below.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha, Mahan Kosh: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ
references.sourceType: Historical Punjabi dictionary entry reproduced digitally

references.scope: Shows that ਸਸਤ੍ਰ is broad and need not exclude ਅਸਤ੍ਰ. The lesson does not turn the pair into a mutually exclusive modern weapon taxonomy.

references.title: Bhai Kahn Singh Nabha, Mahan Kosh: ਬਿਭੂਤ

locator.position: Explanation of ਨ੍ਰਿਸੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ near the lower half of page 65; ਪ੍ਰਭੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ around the middle of page 66.

focusedEvidence.inspectionMethod: Direct visual reading of the locally rendered original PDF pages.
focusedEvidence.sourceObservation: The first explanation and footnote use a destructive sense. A higher-resolution visual recheck of page 66 confirms ਦੋਖੀਆਂ, offenders or adversaries, in the later explanation; it does not say ਦੇਹੀਆਂ, bodies.
focusedEvidence.scopeLimit: The draft's broader dissolution sense at 49.03 follows Neki. Sant Sewa Singh's directed destruction emphasis and the derivative commentary's churning interpretation remain distinct. The lesson does not issue a human command.

locator.position: The opening song/taan pair, then the ਪਾਨ/ਬਾਦ pair with numbered hand/instrument footnotes.

focusedEvidence.inspectionMethod: Direct visual reading, including the bottom-of-page footnotes.
focusedEvidence.sourceObservation: The commentary makes ਤਾਨ musical and identifies ਪਾਨ with the capacity of hands.
focusedEvidence.scopeLimit: Dictionary corroboration is lexical; Neki's drum image and the derivative page's power/instrument taan readings remain visible.

locator.position: Top of page: second half of 51, then the two weapon clauses, complete knower and world-mother pair.

focusedEvidence.inspectionMethod: Direct visual reading of all relevant clauses and the footnote on ਅਸਤ੍ਰ.
focusedEvidence.sourceObservation: The sequence combines greatness, weapon bearing/use, knowing and motherhood.
focusedEvidence.scopeLimit: The paraphrase keeps every clause, without treating greatness as bodily age or motherhood as a biological restriction.

crossUnitConsistency.agreedSimpleEn: I bow to You, the radiance from which every sun receives its light.
crossUnitConsistency.agreedSimplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਸੂਰਜ ਦਾ ਚਾਨਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਤੋਂ ਹੈ।
crossUnitConsistency.validation: Both exported notes share their main strings through constants; exact equality was checked.

crossUnitConsistency.agreedSimpleEn: I bow to You, the honour of all who are honoured.
crossUnitConsistency.agreedSimplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਮਾਣ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
crossUnitConsistency.validation: The companion author agreed these exact main strings. The 46 closing number and the 56 unnumbered line remain distinct source bytes; integration equality must be checked on both imported modules.

authoringAndValidation.method: Read exact frozen Gurmukhi first, inspect the Punjabi commentary, compare limited lexical and poetic alternatives, and author original line explanations and passage observations. No modern translation was imported.
authoringAndValidation.bilingualStudyScope: English and Punjabi unit summaries with the established structured Study fields; no reader schema change.
authoringAndValidation.sourceRecordAccounting: Chhands 50 and 51 each retain two source records. Multiple epithets within a long record are explained without splitting IDs or inflating coverage. Learner-facing prose uses line/ਤੁਕ rather than record.
lookupLimits: No usable direct Mahan Kosh ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥ, ਬ੍ਰਿਧ or ਮਾਣੇ entry was recovered during these lookups; no such entry is cited.
Web PDF screenshots returned text placeholders. The Punjabi PDF was downloaded and rendered locally before a visual-inspection claim was made.
limitations: Assistant research and independent assistant editorial review are not qualified Sikh/Punjabi review, santhiya approval or an approved translation.
All prior source caveats and held sections, including Anand Pauri 24, remain unchanged.
Selected interpretations are educational working senses and do not exhaust the classical or theological range.
Body, music, martial and maternal images are read in passage context without prescriptive ritual, bodily contempt or gender exclusion.
